description: Send the native coin of a network (ETH, S, SOL, TON, ...) from one of the user wallets to another address. This moves real funds and cannot be undone. Call it only when the user explicitly asked to send this exact amount of this asset from this wallet to this recipient on this network; never infer, round or top up any of these values. If anything is missing or ambiguous, ask the user instead of guessing. Returns the transaction hash and an explorer link (also as structuredContent).

allBalance.description: true = send the entire balance of the asset instead of amount. Only when the user explicitly asked to send everything.

amount.description: Amount as an integer string in the smallest unit of the asset (wei, lamports, nanoton, token base units), e.g. "1000000000000000000" = 1 ETH (18 decimals); 1 USDC = "1000000" (6 decimals)

chain.description: Network name: ethereum, optimism, bsc, gnosis, polygon, sonic, zksync, base, avalanche, arbitrum, scroll, solana, ton, hyperevm, plasma, monad, robinhood

from.description: Sender: one of the user wallet addresses from wallet_list, of the type matching the network (evm / solana / ton)

to.description: Recipient address on the same network, exactly as the user gave it. If the user names a saved contact instead of an address, resolve it with address_book_list and confirm the address with the user first

name: transfer_native

link.description: Block explorer link to the transaction

title: Transfer native coin
